draft.inside_message: Happy birthday, Isla! I hear a tooth went missing in August, so I hope the cake is a soft one. Have a brilliant day of dinosaurs and swimming.

artwork_brief.style_note: bold bright confetti, cheerful and simple for a child

draft.rationale: Leans on the lost tooth and her love of dinosaurs and swimming, in a playful godparent voice, with no mention of her age.
